notes:
# Harbor launch plan

Ship the Harbor mobile app to the public on 14 December. Three gates before then: beta feedback closed, the pricing page signed off, and the app store review passed. Mia owns the Android build and Priya owns pricing.

# Harbor pricing notes

Two tiers: Free and Plus at $6 a month. Priya wants an annual plan at $60. Decision due by 20 November.

# Harbor beta feedback

42 testers so far. Top complaints: slow sync on Android and a confusing onboarding screen. Testers love the offline mode.
harbor standup: Mia says the android build is flaky, retry friday. Priya is waiting on legal for the annual plan.

# Meeting with Priya

Agreed to cut the referral feature from launch. Actions: Priya drafts the pricing page by Friday, I review the onboarding copy, Mia fixes the sync bug.

# Dentist

Check-up booked for 21 November at 2:30pm with Dr Patel. Ask about the night guard.
dentist said floss more, next clean in six months. cost was $180

# Anna

Anna's birthday is 3 December. She likes pottery and Japanese food. Her number is 0412 345 678. She moved to Melbourne in June.

# Call with Anna

Anna is visiting on 28 November. She wants to try the new ramen place. She recommended the book Piranesi.

# Mia

Mia is the Android lead on Harbor. Her birthday is 9 February. She prefers messages over calls.

# Japan trip

Flights booked for 12 March, returning 26 March. Tokyo for 5 nights, then Kyoto for 4 nights, then Osaka for 3. Budget is $4,500. Travelling with Sam.

# Kyoto ideas

Fushimi Inari at sunrise. Arashiyama bamboo grove. Tea ceremony in Gion. Day trip to Nara for the deer.

# Tokyo food list

Ramen at Ichiran. Sushi at Tsukiji outer market. Tonkatsu at Maisen. Coffee at Fuglen.
jr pass is not worth it under 7 days apparently. sam says get a suica card instead

# Statistics lecture 1

Mean, median and spread. The standard deviation measures how far values sit from the mean.

# Statistics lecture 2

Sampling and error bars. A confidence interval gets narrower as the sample grows.

# Stats exam

The statistics exam is on 24 November at 9am in room B204. Covers lectures 1 to 8. Bring a calculator. Worth 40% of the grade.

# Reading list

- Piranesi
- Thinking, Fast and Slow
- The Overstory
- Klara and the Sun

# Piranesi

By Susanna Clarke. Finished it on 28 October. Loved the House and the tides; the ending felt rushed. Four stars.

# Budget November

Rent 650. Groceries 140. Gym 45. Phone 30. Eating out 90.

# Budget October

Rent 650. Groceries 120. Gym 45. Phone 30. Eating out 160.

# Gym routine

Monday: squats and rows. Wednesday: bench and pull-ups. Friday: deadlifts. Three sets of eight.

# Running log

2 November: 5 km in 27:40 along the river. 26 October: 5 km in 28:55. Goal is 10 km by January.
ran 6km this morning, felt good, knee a bit sore after

# Banana bread

Ingredients: 3 ripe bananas, 250 g flour, 100 g sugar, 2 eggs, 80 g butter, 1 tsp baking soda.

Mash the bananas, mix everything, bake at 175 degrees for 50 minutes.

# Lasagne

Ingredients: 500 g beef mince, lasagne sheets, 700 ml passata, bechamel, parmesan.

Layer and bake at 190 degrees for 40 minutes.

# Todo

- [ ] renew passport by 30 November
- [ ] email landlord about the leak
- [x] book flights
- [ ] buy Anna a birthday present

# Car service

Service due 15 December at Northside Motors. Rego expires 3 January. Last service cost $420.

# Garden

Planted tomatoes and basil on 5 October. Water every second day. The lemon tree needs feeding in spring.
idea: an app that reminds you to water plants based on the weather forecast

# Wifi

Network is Bluegum-5G. Router is in the hallway cupboard. Restart it if the light blinks orange.
landlord called back, plumber is coming thursday between 8 and 10
feeling pretty tired today, slept badly. need to prep for the stats exam this week

# Quarterly review

Goals for the half: ship Harbor, mentor one junior, present at the team offsite. Rating last half: exceeds.
